topic: The rumor that incognito mode makes you anonymous online
title: Does Incognito Mode Make You Anonymous? #siliconverdict #privacy #rumormill
description: A common rumor says incognito mode makes you invisible online. We weigh what it actually does and who can still see you.
pinned_comment: Believed or doubted? Reply with one word.

scenes.narration: Many people think incognito mode makes them invisible online. It doesn't.
Stay to the end, because one detail surprises almost everyone.
It does one thing: your browser forgets your history and cookies when you close the window.
But websites, a school or work network, and your provider can still see the traffic.
So it protects you from the next person using your device, not from the internet.
As a claim of anonymity, the rumor is only roughly ten percent plausible.
Real privacy takes more, like blocking trackers and being careful what you sign into.
So the call is clear: incognito is a tidy-up tool, not an invisibility cloak.
Use it for shared computers, gift shopping, or signing into two accounts at once.
Know a tool's limits, and it becomes useful instead of misleading.
Follow for more tech. Did you believe it, or did you doubt it?
